subject: Request: Maintain Pilot Access During Procurement Remediation (conditional usage cap)
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Tom Bailey <tom.bailey@acrohealth.io>, Natasha Reed <n.reed@acrohealth.io>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Maintain Pilot Access During Procurement Remediation (conditional usage cap)

Hi Tom / Natasha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — appreciate you walking through the HL7 ingestion flow. I heard from Natasha that procurement is asking for an extra round of vendor checks and the PO is likely to slip past your original date. Totally understand — these things happen.

To avoid losing momentum on your side, would AcroHealth be open to a short, conditional extension for the pilot environment? We can: 
- Provision a temporary voucher for 100k tokens valid for 14 days,
- Restrict concurrency to 5 RPS and cap model size to the light inference profile, and
- Require a PO within 30 days to transition to paid (or we disable access).

If that sounds acceptable, I can loop in Camila and get the formal voucher terms over today. If finance needs a slightly longer runway, tell me how many days you need and we can try to accommodate.

Goal: keep the sandbox live so your clinical team can finish the integration tests.

Best,

Evelyn Hart
Senior Enterprise AE
Redwood Inference
E: evelyn@redwood.com | M: (415) 555-0124

On Thu, 02 Dec 2026 at 09:12, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Tom / Natasha,
> 
> Thanks again for the demo last week — appreciate you walking through the HL7 ingestion flow...

Evelyn — thanks for the quick note. Procurement has flagged some questions about data residency and indemnity language that need legal's sign-off; right now the earliest they expect to clear the PO is Dec 10. We really don't want to lose the sandbox while our clinicians are doing integration tests.

The conditional voucher sounds promising. Two quick clarifications before we accept: 
1) Will the voucher allow us to invite 3 additional engineers to the org (we need parallel testing)?
2) Is the token cap 100k total or 100k per day?

If you can confirm those, I'll raise it with Natasha and finance. If needed, a +10 day extension would be ideal.

Thanks,
Tom
Director of Engineering
AcroHealth

Thanks Tom — good questions.

Short answers: 1) We can open the org to +3 engineers for the duration of the voucher. 2) The 100k is total tokens for the voucher period (not per day).

Camila — can you confirm the exact voucher terms and upload the stub agreement? Also copying David from Finance in case there are billing flags on our side we should be aware of.

Tom / Natasha — if a 10-day window is what you need, call it out and we'll aim for a 10- or 14-day voucher depending on final approvals. Appreciate the heads-up on the PO date (Dec 10).

Best,
Evelyn

Hi all — looping in commercial — happy to help. Per Evelyn's ask, here's what Redwood can do right away: 

- Provision a 14-day conditional voucher (starts when we activate it).
- Token allowance: 100,000 total tokens.
- Seats: add up to 3 additional engineer seats (total org seats during voucher: existing + 3).
- Throughput: soft cap at 5 RPS to preserve capacity.
- Activation condition: voucher active upon signature of the attached one-page acceptance form; full contract/PO required within 30 days to avoid shutdown.
- Non-refundable; if PO isn't received by day 30 we will disable new tokens and deliver a usage report.

I've attached: 1) conditional_voucher_terms.pdf (stub) and 2) procurement_timeline_template.xlsx (same template Evelyn mentioned).

If that works, reply with "Confirm voucher" and we'll schedule activation immediately after you sign the acceptance form (I can email a DocuSign if helpful).
